description: Agent Consent: submit the grant’s renewal terms, the changes since it was given and the moment the use continues: the grant with its id, when it was given, when the principal last confirmed it, how often it must be confirmed again (such as 12 months), how it renews (by the principal’s confirmation, by itself, or not at all) and when the agent last asked the principal to confirm; each change since the grant with its id, when it happened, its kind (a new purpose, new data, a new recipient, a new actor, new terms or a wider use), the change as written and when the principal agreed to it; and optionally the days before the due date that count as pending (30 when left out). The signed report gives the grant with its interval in days, every change with its status as confirmed, unconfirmed or after_read, and a timeline with the due date and the days to it, with counts, and names fresh consent needed before the use continues: a confirmation date already passed and a change the principal has not agreed to by the moment the use continues; then a grant that renews by itself, a due date inside the warning window, a confirmation request still unanswered and an interval with no length, with the fix for each. The due date is the last confirmation, or the grant, plus the interval read in days, months at 30 days. This reads re-confirmation and the changes that need fresh consent: a payout change needing the counterparty’s fresh approval is wever_payout-change-check, one sharing event needing fresh consent under the owner’s rules is wever_context-sharing-check, how a delegation renews when it lapses is wever_delegation-expiry-check and amending a trading or treasury mandate is wever_mandate-amend. Verdict consent_renewal_overdue, consent_renewal_pending, consent_renewal_terms_unknown or consent_renewal_current. POST /api/consent-renewal-check. Reads only the recorded consent material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no principal is contacted, no consent is requested, recorded, renewed or withdrawn and no data is used, moved or deleted. Agent Consent reads the grant the principal gave before the agent uses data or acts on it: whether the grant covers this use, whether it is still in force, whether it was withdrawn, whether the record proves it, what it was given for, whether the data may pass on and whether fresh consent is due. It is not the agent’s authority to act (wever_authority-scope-check reads an agent’s access list against the authority grant its operator gave it; a consent check reads the grant the principal gave over their own data: authority is not consent, and consent is not authority), not a mandate (the wever_mandate tools, wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-revoke and wever_mandate-draft, issue and change what an agent may trade or spend for a principal; a consent check reads what the principal agreed may be done with their data and changes nothing), not a data sample (wever_data-evidence-check reads a dataset sample’s fields and types; a consent check reads the permission behind using the data, not the data itself), not terms against a purchase (wever_terms-match-check reads purchases already made against their governing terms; a consent grant is the principal’s permission, not a seller’s terms), not a promise (the wever_commitment checks read what the agent promised; consent is what the principal granted, and an agent’s promise never stands in for it) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a consent check reads whether the principal’s grant allows the work at all). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-consent-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-consent/.

changes.description: Changes since the grant was given that bear on it.

confirmed_at.description: When the principal agreed to it.

id.description: The change id, such as c1.

kind.description: A new purpose, new data, a new recipient, a new actor, new terms or a wider use.

continues_at.description: When the use continues; the moment the renewal is read at.

last_confirmed_at.description: When the principal last confirmed it.

reconfirm_every.description: How often it must be confirmed again, such as 12 months.

renewal.description: How it renews: by the principal’s confirmation, by itself, or not at all.

request_sent_at.description: When the agent last asked the principal to confirm.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

warn_days.description: Days before the due date that count as pending; 30 when left out.
